decisions.reason: The air quality module had its own page, fits the modular platform's growing environmental sensing line, and costs little to keep listed, so the option is still worth holding.
As the current generation replacing version 2.0, the voltage measurement module is a core building block with stable demand and minimal carrying cost.
The CAN bus interface serves industrial and automotive users of the platform, has no successor in sight, and is cheap to keep within the shared firmware and API infrastructure.

The CO2 module still appears on its own page, but this firm routinely replaces modules with new hardware generations and component shortages raise carrying costs, so replacement by a successor is a real risk, though keeping it remains slightly more likely.
